title: combineStreams takes two bare strings, so a swapped call site typechecks clean and silently reverses the load-bearing stderr-first ordering
description:
Residue of CAM-368 (PR #298), found by the orchestrator during story verification; review round 1 returned CLEAN without raising it.

CAM-368 extracted `combineStreams(stderr: string, stdout: string): string` in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts and converted the four failing-step return sites to call it. That successfully gave the JOIN ordering a single definition point, and a direct unit test now pins it (`combineStreams('ERRLINE','OUTLINE').split('\n')[0] === 'ERRLINE'`).

But the ARGUMENT ordering is still per-site and completely unguarded. Both parameters are bare `string`, so a call site written as `combineStreams(checkout.stdout, checkout.stderr)` typechecks cleanly, passes every existing test, and silently reverses the invariant at that one step. Since `detail` reaches the operator through truncatePreflightDetail as FIRST LINE ONLY (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-139, consumed at src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1607), a reversal buries the actual verdict behind banner chatter -- which is the exact failure mode that made the original CAM-363 incident undiagnosable.

So the invariant moved from 'duplicated at 4 sites, pinned at 2' to 'defined once, but re-specified by hand at 4 call sites'. Better, not closed.

PROPOSED FIX (makes the swap unrepresentable rather than merely tested): change the signature to accept the spawn result object directly, e.g. `combineStreams(r: { stdout: string; stderr: string }): string`. All four call sites already have the whole result object in hand (`checkout`, `pull`, `typecheck`, `tests`), so each becomes `combineStreams(checkout)` and there is no argument order left to get wrong. The PlanPreflightSpawnFn return type is already exactly that shape, so the parameter can be typed structurally against it.

IN SCOPE: the signature change, the four call sites (src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:98,105,125,132), and updating the direct unit tests at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:46,50,54,58 to the object form while keeping their strict `toBe` assertions and the stderr-first ordering case.

OUT OF SCOPE: the clean-tree step (still stdout-only by design); loopSpawnFn at src/commands/sidecar.ts, which carries the identical stderr drop and is deferred separately; any change to the required-ness of `stderr` on PlanPreflightSpawnFn.

NOTE: this is a sidecar-executed file, so shipping it requires a coherence rebuild.
